17tdoi.Suggaz: A Suggaz: an unseen pit-beast in the mire of the swamp that seizes Lone Wolf's leg in strong jaws and tries to drag him under (sections 27, 210, 285, 337). The Suggaz is a bog creature of the Plane of Darkness with powerful jaws and a vice-like grip (wiki)
17tdoi.Deathlord Ixiataaga (with Deathstaff—unc: Deathlord Ixiataaga, a horned skeletal lord of Ixia freed from his cage of light, fought at the Shadow Gate while he holds the not-yet-charged Deathstaff (sections 77 and 214)
17tdoi.Dentaag: Dentaag: six spindly-limbed black insectoids with ghoulish faces, born from the black smoke of the Shadow Gate chamber, immune to most psychic attack (sections 43 and 237). The Dentaag are wispy psychic beings that can solidify into black insectoids with composite eyes and shiny shells that sprout razor spines (wiki)
17tdoi.Drakkarim Undead: Undead Drakkarim guards in armour, two spearmen at a great grey door, fought bare-handed (sections 243 and 336)
17tdoi.Drakkarim Marines (undead): A horde of screeching undead Drakkarim marines that rush Lone Wolf on the ship, bloodless and rubbery to the blade (section 260)
17tdoi.Undead Drakkarim Search Party (in psychi: An undead Drakkarim search party after Lone Wolf's psychic blast has stunned them, weak but sensitive to psychic attack (section 279)
17tdoi.Undead Drakkarim Search Party: An undead Drakkarim search party hunting Lone Wolf, ghoulish warriors who leap on him from all sides (section 31)
17tdoi.Lavas: Lavas: horny-skinned, golden-winged dragon-like flyers that escort Tagazin on the Plane of Darkness (sections 38 and 347). Lavas are servants of Naar from the Plane of Darkness, with plated limbs and bellies, snaky tongues in their beaks, and talons; vulnerable around the eyes (wiki)
17tdoi.Bulkhead Door: The Bulkhead Door: a locked bronze-banded door, fought as an enemy by prying at its lock until its endurance is gone (sections 74 and 81)

18dotd.Eldenoran Ambushers: A horde of leather-clad Eldenoran men with swords and spears who spring from hiding among rocks and pines on a hill road after Lone Wolf's horse is shot out from under him (sections 107, 183, 278)
18dotd.Castle Guardsmen: The impostor guardsmen of Castle Tranius, minions of the dark disciple who has taken the castle, who rush out with drawn swords after Lone Wolf and Lord Nathor leap from the hall window (sections 52, 137, 269, 273)
18dotd.Hounds of Vikkak: A pack of wolf-like hounds, immune to most psychic attacks, that attack Lone Wolf on the track near the bridge on the road to Scade, after Castle Tranius (sections 144, 304). They are fanged wolf-like creatures with yellow eyes, born of dark sorcery (wiki)
18dotd.Thieves of Varetta: A gang of rogues who creep up behind Lone Wolf at a door in Varetta, lured by a youth's offer of rest (section 155)
18dotd.Lavas: Naar's winged Lavas: hard-skinned, beaked flying horrors with talons and a scything horny tail, the air troops attacking the Kai Monastery and guarding the Shadow Gate (sections 58, 165, 178, 192, 303, 344). Lavas are servants of Naar from the Plane of Darkness, enslaved to the dragon Huan'zhor, with golden-shimmering horny hides and plated limbs and bellies (wiki)
18dotd.Eldenoran Thug: A drunken Eldenoran bandit with a dagger who is menacing a young woman and her child at the abbey; Lone Wolf cuts him down (sections 167, 311)
18dotd.Prince Lutha: Lutha, the low-born usurper styling himself Prince of Duadon, ruler of Eldenora, who wears the Ring of Power and fights Lone Wolf with a dagger at the pit's trapdoor (sections 9, 172, 306)
18dotd.Eldenoran war-dogs: The big war-dogs of an Eldenoran pack, sent into a frenzy by the scent of their leader's blood, immune to most psychic attacks (sections 73, 216)
18dotd.Vaxagore: A dragon of Naar's herd on the Plane of Darkness, immune to most psychic attacks, fought beside the Shadow Gate (sections 98, 239). Vaxagore is a coppery red dragon made by Naar to destroy the second-order Kai Lords: as large as a galleon, swift on foot, breathing blue flame, and leader of Naar's dragon army (wiki)
18dotd.Ghost of Roark: The restless spirit of Roark, the evil lordling of Amory and one-time disciple of the Demonlord Tagazin, who rides a flame-breathing black horse through the dead city and shrieks at Lone Wolf's mind (sections 39, 253)
18dotd.Bargee: A bargee in the Quarlen tavern who is really a master thief, hiding a stolen purse of gems in his boot (section 26)
18dotd.Lavas Sky Patrol: A flight of Lavas on patrol over the Durncrag mountains which spots Lone Wolf as he approaches the Kai Monastery (section 314)
18dotd.Eldenoran Horse-scouts: Half a dozen Eldenoran scouts from a hut on the plain who burst out with weapons after Lone Wolf punches their trooper (section 33)
18dotd.Eldenoran brigands: A gang of Eldenoran saddle-bandits led by a chief, who charge Lone Wolf on the plains and fight on after he kills their leader (sections 63, 336)
18dotd.Duadon guardsmen: A unit of Duadon city guards, armed with spears and throwing nets and led by a one-eyed sergeant, who try to take Lone Wolf at the west gate after the Cener Druid raises the alarm (section 50)
18dotd.Eldenoran Assault Troops: Eldenoran soldiers in a trench who leap on Lone Wolf when he appears among them (section 57)

19wb.Cryopedeans: Naar's Cryopedeans: lean, rubbery-limbed, clawed horrors with needle fangs that come out of the smoky walls of his throne hall to stop Lone Wolf reaching the Shadow Gate (sections 111, 162, 201)
19wb.Golasyx: A giant predatory dragonfly that stabs with its spear-like proboscis, attacking Lone Wolf while he rides a small dragonfly up the gorge (sections 75, 116, 340). The Golasyx is a larger relative of the Solyx, from Avaros (wiki)
19wb.Crypt Spawn Horde: A horde of shrieking bat-winged horrors that look like deformed human brains with skeletal limbs, summoned by Naar from the walls of his throne room (sections 3, 123, 147)
19wb.Mech-wulf: A mechanical wolf of metal plates and rods with a glowing eye, immune to psychic attack, that bounds at Lone Wolf out of the darkness (sections 14, 44, 127, 299, 322)
19wb.Caq: A small, round, pudding-like creature with pale green dead-looking eyes, fat lips and a sac of venom under its tongue, immune to psychic attack. It hides behind old books on the highest of the sagging shelves in a narrow hall of curios, grins, then spits corroding acid; Lone Wolf climbs the shaky shelving and pins it at the end of the top shelf (sections 294, 117, 284, 141). (wiki for the venom sac)
19wb.Kataka: A huge black beast with gleaming fangs, a gaping maw and a thick muscular neck, fast and immune to most psychic attack. Lone Wolf, hunting Wolf's Bane through a dark cellar, senses warmth behind a heap of rotting timbers; with an unearthly howl the beast rears up and springs over the heap onto him (section 168). (wiki for its build)
19wb.Ukara: A huge serpent held by a chain and iron collar in the cavern pool, with a barbed tail; evil eyes, immune to most psychic attack (sections 2, 128, 169). The Ukara is a snake from the planet Avaros, its body studded with tiny barbed horns (wiki)
19wb.Meghanic: An armoured castle guardian, a hovering helm over empty plate armour, not a living being, which strikes at the mind with a green flash then comes with its sword (sections 109, 181, 265). Meghanics are warriors from another world, plate-armoured with heads that hover just above their bodies (wiki)
19wb.Rahjaz: A huge sabre-fanged tiger-like beast that roars out of the dark in the tunnel beneath the hut (sections 27, 188, 306). The Rahjaz is a striped tiger-like beast from Avaros with four horns above its eyes (wiki)
19wb.Avarosi: The grey-skinned, ghoulish, thin spearmen of the sunless Avarosi hall, who rush to guard the stairs when they smell Lone Wolf (section 193). The Avarosi are grey-skinned humanoids of the planet Avaros, with ghoulish eyes and an excellent sense of smell (wiki)
19wb.Ekmakon: A hungry cellar beast with rubbery skin, glowing red eyes, clawed hands and a fanged jaw, breathing with a single lung. It lives in a cellar flooded with black salt water in the dead city; when Lone Wolf falls in through a collapsing wall it grabs at him from the dark, hauls him down to the cellar floor to drown him, and he fights it there underwater (sections 324, 145, 194, 237, 9)
19wb.Knoarcs: Frog-like reptilians with jagged bone swords who climb out of a metal pot in the mire and attack, immune to most psychic attack (section 213)
19wb.Bangrol: A razor-taloned bird that swoops out of a chimney at Lone Wolf (sections 217, 241). The Bangrol is an aggressive Sommlending sea eagle with bright plumage, oversized talons and a slightly serrated beak, a nocturnal hunter whose call carries for miles (wiki)
19wb.Manoyd: An armoured humanoid guard in visored helm and power gloves, one of two walking to the black tower; Lone Wolf strips the other's armour (section 276). Manoyds are thin, pale-skinned humanoids of Avaros, a world ruled by Naar, resembling emaciated Drakkarim with weak bones and muscle (wiki)
19wb.Temple Portal: Not a creature: the door of the black glass temple of Avaros, at the top of its stairway in a howling sandstorm, a seamless slab of lead-lined iron in a glassy arch with two dull red gem plates for its lock. Lone Wolf prises the plates off and batters the bared mechanism apart while the storm wears him down (sections 251, 283)
19wb.Solyx: A giant insect with a lance-like proboscis in the plant jungle, immune to most psychic attack (section 311). The Solyx is a dragonfly-like creature of Avaros with big gossamer wings, sometimes used as a flying mount (wiki)

20tcon.Kekataag the Avenger: Naar's champion, an undead skull-faced warrior in slime-dulled golden armour hung with skulls and bones, who wields a great two-handed axe and bursts out of the chamber wall; Skarn-Ska and the Sommerswerd hurt him especially (sections 121, 211, 282)
20tcon.Zantaz: The towering warrior in black plate armour who guards the dragon-gate, with a runed broadsword wreathed in black fire and a poisoned dagger; he has no mind of his own and is immune to psychic attack (sections 147, 254, 310)
20tcon.Haemodyls: Hostile moss-covered vine creatures with hundreds of hollow barbs that whip at Lone Wolf on the jungle trail (sections 24, 46, 193, 226, 299, 304, 345). A Haemodyl is a moss-covered living vine with sticky green blood that squeals when hurt (wiki)
20tcon.Avagnids: Giant spiked spiders (arachnids) that lurk in the muddy water by the bank and leap out at Lone Wolf (sections 30, 94, 197)
20tcon.Muntaag swarm: A swarm of giant wasp-like insects with whirling tail-blades in the swamp, especially vulnerable to psychic attack (sections 212, 318). The Muntaag are winged insects with scarlet-tipped, knife-like stingers on their tails, which build pear-shaped hives (wiki)
20tcon.Ghazoul: A heavy hyena-like beast that pounces from a ramp, immune to most psychic attack (sections 74, 234). The Ghazoul is a hyena-like sabre-toothed beast with a straggly mane, dull glowing eyes and lightning speed; it loves Muntaag honey and its spit carries a plague bacterium (wiki)
20tcon.Chaos-mutants: Undead mutated beings, rotting skeletal things that rise from the earth and swarm through the shelter's entrance, immune to psychic attack (section 32)
20tcon.Nemagog swarm: A flood of maggot-larvae called up by the spirit of Cadak, which grow and mutate; Animal Mastery or Grand Mastery eases the fight (sections 69, 92)
20tcon.Lavas sentry: A golden-winged Lavas on guard at the tower archway who tries to block Lone Wolf's escape and raise the alarm (section 93)
20tcon.Huan’zhor the Dragonlord: Huan'zhor, a huge dragon who dwells on a nest of flames amid his treasure, immune to most psychic attack and fought when he discovers Lone Wolf (sections 64, 185)
